# Scanner decoder

`zxing-0.21.3.min.js` is the unmodified UMD minified distribution of `@zxing/library` 0.21.3 from npm, used only as a browser barcode decoding fallback.

Upstream: https://github.com/zxing-js/library

License: Apache-2.0. The bundled `ts-custom-error` dependency is MIT licensed. Both license texts are included in `zxing-LICENSE`.

The server has no new npm runtime dependency. Browser camera frames are decoded locally.
